entries.title: Tunic

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best archival route because it offers the complete game with native PC capture/settings flexibility. The later PlayStation and Switch releases add access options, but no sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Tunic on Steam for Windows PC and play the native PC build. Use console versions only for ecosystem preference or portability.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or content-expanded edition is documented.
